question: Dermatitis is a symptom of a disease caused by the deficiency (incompleteness) of which?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamins**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pellagra** is a **disease caused by low levels of niacin** (Vitamin B3).
 
• It's** **marked by** Dementia, Diarrhea, and Dermatitis, **also known as** D3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
